title: Tile set freeze verification - immutable tile set enforcement

defect_summary.metadata_before_freeze: Tile metadata and manifest generation ran BEFORE all tile repairs (S-invariant, seam repair, link scrubbing) were complete. This meant metadata/manifest could reflect stale/incomplete tiles.
defect_summary.no_freeze_enforcement: No mechanism prevented tile mutations after metadata/manifest generation. Ad-hoc scripts could mutate tiles after manifest creation, invalidating the manifest.
defect_summary.no_tileset_digest: No tileset digest (SHA256 of all tile files) was recorded, making it impossible to verify that the tile set hasn't been tampered with after freeze.

corrected_semantics.TILESET_FROZEN marker: A .tileset_frozen marker file is written after all tile repairs complete. Contains tileset_digest_sha256 (SHA256 of all tiles), tile_count, frozen_at_utc, and references to metadata/manifest paths.
corrected_semantics.freeze_tileset(): Computes SHA256 of all tile files, writes .tileset_frozen marker, returns freeze metadata including tileset_digest_sha256.
corrected_semantics._assert_tileset_frozen(): Called by generate_metadata() and write_manifest() to enforce that metadata/manifest can ONLY be generated from a frozen tileset.
corrected_semantics._assert_tileset_not_frozen(): Called by TileExtractor.tile() to prevent tile generation into an already-frozen directory (prevents accidental overwrite).

modified_tests: test_generate_metadata_scans_tiles_dir - now calls freeze_tileset before generate_metadata
test_write_manifest_computes_origin_from_min_bbox_by_default - creates tile file + freeze_tileset before write_manifest
test_write_manifest_skips_settings_snapshot_key - creates tile file + freeze_tileset before write_manifest
test_write_manifest_explicit_origin_overrides_computed - creates tile file + freeze_tileset before write_manifest

regression_results.tiles_suite: 85 passed, 1 skipped (tile_extractor + tile_metadata + tile_fbx_generator + tile_equivalence + runtime_tile_builder)

residual_risks: TileExtractor.tile() still allows re-running tile extraction on an unfrozen directory. If called twice, the second run will overwrite the first tileset. A production workflow should call freeze_tileset() immediately after the first TileExtractor.tile() call.

The .tileset_frozen marker is a plain JSON file. A malicious actor could delete it and re-mutate tiles. For production, consider writing the freeze marker atomically and verifying its integrity on read.
freeze_tileset() computes SHA256 of all tile files sequentially. For very large tilesets (thousands of tiles), this could take seconds. Consider parallel hashing for large tilesets.
